target.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner
target.body:
## Summary

- add a guarded FakeCo-only CloudFormation owner for one private ARM64 ClickClack VM in the dedicated member account
- reuse an explicitly supplied VPC, private subnet, and active egress path; allow TCP 8080 only from approved source security groups
- add protected manual plan/apply/verify/teardown operations with exact account, network, AMI, storage, security-group, and workload-IAM replay
- add deterministic SSM bootstrap, seed equality, health/readiness, metadata-only metrics, runtime identity, SQLite backup/integrity, restore, and retained-data teardown proof
- document the account foundation, exact Environment inputs, costs, durations, canary handoff, fail-closed restore procedure, and disposal boundary

Production Cloudflare Worker, Container, Postgres, R2, domains, release, and version paths are unchanged.

## Safety boundary

- `plan` is the default and never executes its change set
- `apply` rejects resource removals and actual or conditional replacement
- no public IP, SSH key, port 22 rule, VPC, subnet, route table, NAT gateway, load balancer, or DNS resource is created
- the instance role is inline-policy-only, permissions-boundary constrained, and limited to SSM plus exact artifact/log/backup/KMS destinations
- verify and teardown fail closed on live instance, volume, security-group, instance-profile, trust-policy, boundary, tag, inline-policy, release, and runtime-image drift
- rollback-safe teardown derives the one running commit, verifies its release/image/state identity, and preserves failed-update artifacts until the retained-volume snapshot
- teardown takes a fresh hot backup and encrypted snapshot, retains the root volume and versioned manifest, and contains no implicit data-delete path
- restore derives commit, bucket, runtime-scoped key, and checksum from one evidence file inside a fail-fast shell before stopping the app
- workflow inputs contain identifiers only; no GitHub or application secret values are added

## Validation

Exact candidate: `dccbeb8aa31926fd6e93e0360017dbb5f8ca1ab2` / tree `fac6286746016507dd4d38f23ffa52b774ba8ebe`.

Diff: 12 files, 4,753 insertions, 24 deletions; SHA-256 `fbebfe6744ccfe7fe274bd504368148e68d8f7ba1a8ffa6ddac44b4b4c80c11c`. Source archive SHA-256: `1a8c9511030247bf530c01edca8d35d99f7101a659ab2b16c7575658d4972804`.

- `pnpm check`
- `pnpm docs:site`
- `pnpm coverage` — 86.5%
- `pnpm test:e2e` — 46 passed
- `pnpm test:fakeco-aws` — 28 passed, including explicit rollback/runtime and cleanup mutations
- `actionlint .github/workflows/fakeco-aws.yml`
- `shellcheck deploy/fakeco/aws/bootstrap.sh` and ShellCheck/Bash syntax proof for the rendered restore block
- `uvx --from cfn-lint cfn-lint deploy/fakeco/aws/template.json`
- exact-head Docker buildx `linux/arm64` and `linux/amd64` builds, cache-only with no registry output
- source-blind local behavior validation — satisfies contract, confidence 0.98; teardown/apply/verify mismatch behavior, zero/multiple runtime containers, release/image identity drift, requested/observed/mixed pins, cleanup ordering, dual-commit retention, and fail-closed restore evidence covered
- canonical autoreview chain — actionable findings repaired; final mutation-test commit clean at 0.98 and fail-closed restore repair clean at 0.94

## Review repairs

- replace the unavailable Noble `awscli` apt dependency with a versioned official ARM64 archive whose SHA-256 was derived after verifying the AWS CLI Team signature
- accept reserved CloudFormation `aws:` tags during live replay while retaining exact rejection of every unexpected customer-owned tag
- grant `AWS-RunRemoteScript` its required `s3:ListBucket` only on the artifact bucket and owner-script subprefix
- bound SSM script execution and clean obsolete commit-scoped VM build artifacts without deleting data volumes
- make teardown rollback-safe when the stack commit advances but the previous verified release is still serving; evidence records both stack and runtime commits
- bind restore to the selected backup evidence and owner Compose override; invalid commit, key scope, checksum, or image pins abort before the app stops
- remove the release-owned changelog edit

Public Model Identifier Gate: **PASS**. Candidate diff, exact source archive, tests, fixtures/snapshots, workflow, generated validation evidence, and this planned public proof contain zero blocking unknown identifiers. The model-bearing canary example uses a public provider identifier documented by [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5), and the compound router syntax is documented by [ClawRouter](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/blob/main/docs/openclaw.md).

## Remaining live-proof gate

No AWS resource, GitHub Environment, secret, account, workflow dispatch, release, version, tag, or registry artifact was created while preparing this PR. Read-only availability checks found no configured `fakeco` Environment and no authenticated member-account identity. Merge remains gated on redacted authenticated account preflight and CloudFormation plan plus live apply/verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown proof after the service identity and protected Environment are available. The manual workflow must not be dispatched and this PR must not merge until that external gate is satisfied or the owner gives an explicit item-specific waiver.
